description.content: Starts the execution of a query that will finish with the export of the results to a file in S3. The service response contains an identifier that can be used in the "status" operation to obtain the URL of the file with the results.

query.description: (Required) Identifier of the query which is going to be executed.
Key and value of the parameters to be replaced within the NQL query in order to compose a final query for execution. Example: {\"alert_name\": \"my_alert\", \"alert_status\": \"Open\"}"
The compression algorithm for the export. If not set, no compression is applied. Allowed values: `NONE`, `ZSTD`, `GZIP`.
